1. crates/djls-conf/src/lib.rs (LOG_DIR static) — `Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf(...).unwrap()` can panic if `proj_dirs.cache_dir()` is not valid UTF-8 (platform-dependent, especially on Linux with unusual locale/XDG env vars). The PR checklist claims "Replace unwrap with graceful fallback for UTF-8 conversion" but the diff still contains `.unwrap()`. Should use `.ok()` / fall back to `/tmp` (or another safe default) on conversion failure, matching the stated intent.

2. crates/djls-server/src/logging.rs (`init_tracing`, `std::fs::create_dir_all` failure path) — if directory creation fails, the code only prints a warning via `eprintln!` and then proceeds to call `tracing_appender::rolling::daily(log_dir.as_std_path(), ...)` anyway, which will likely panic internally (that API panics on failure to create the appender) or silently fail to log. Should either fall back to a known-good directory (e.g. `/tmp`) on creation failure, or propagate/handle the error so the server doesn't crash/silently lose logging when the XDG cache dir is unwritable.

3. crates/djls-conf/src/lib.rs (`LOG_DIR` as `LazyLock<Utf8PathBuf>`) — moving directory creation out of this module (per the checklist "Move all log directory logic including creation to djls-conf function") was apparently intended but the diff shows `LOG_DIR` is just a path constant with no creation logic, and `create_dir_all` is still called in djls-server. This mismatches the PR's own checklist and the explicit maintainer request to centralize "directory logic including creation" in djls-conf. Either update the checklist/description or actually move `create_dir_all` into djls-conf (e.g. as part of a `log_dir()` function) so djls-server just gets a guaranteed-usable path back.

4. crates/djls-server/src/logging.rs (`eprintln!` on dir-creation failure) — printing directly to stderr bypasses the tracing/LSP logging infrastructure this module exists to set up, and in an LSP server stdout/stderr may be part of the protocol transport or swallowed by the client depending on transport mode. This warning will likely never be seen by the user. Should surface this via the existing `send_message` mechanism or at minimum document why stderr is acceptable here.

5. crates/djls-conf/src/lib.rs (tests `log_dir_tests`) — `test_log_dir_xdg_pattern` only asserts something when `ProjectDirs::from` succeeds and trivially passes otherwise, and `test_log_dir_returns_path` asserts a tautology no matter what `LOG_DIR` evaluates to (either branch of the OR is basically guaranteed by construction). These tests don't exercise the fallback-on-UTF8-failure path or the directory-creation failure path, so the two new behaviors claimed as tested in the checklist ("Add tests for XDG directory logic", "Replace unwrap with graceful fallback") aren't actually verified.
